editorial:
Imagine taking a team-building trip with your boss, only to find out he is a total nightmare. You follow an ad-agency leader played by Alan Alda who drags his employees on a white-water rafting trip. At first, it seems like a fun way to bond, but the vibe shifts quickly. You will see how a simple vacation turns into a fight for survival as the group heads deeper into the wilderness. The movie does a great job of showing how power plays in the office can turn dangerous when there are no walls around you and only a rushing river for company.

What really makes this work is the tension between the characters. You can feel the stress building up as things go wrong. The pacing is steady, though some parts feel like a typical TV movie from the nineties. If you like stories where people are pushed to their limits, you will enjoy this one. Since it is an older film, you might want to look for a remastered version to add to your 4K Blu-ray collection, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. It is a solid pick for a rainy afternoon.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a brutal fight for survival after the group crashes. The boss tries to maintain control even in the wild, but his ego leads to disaster. After several people are lost to the river and the elements, the survivors finally realize the boss is a danger to them. The twist comes when the power dynamic flips, and the employees must save themselves from both the river and their boss's madness to get home.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival stories and corporate drama.
